transcript.answer: Lore's event-router was deleted on 2026-10-02. PR #2491, "The event-router is deleted", merged at 22:13 UTC that day. The ADR-044 amendment of the same date records it as folded into lore-api. GitHub webhooks now land on lore-api's `POST /api/webhook/github`. That route verifies the HMAC and writes `pipeline.events` on lore-api's own pool. The public `/api/events` URL is unchanged, because the ingresses route both public webhook hostnames to lore-api and rewrite `/api/events` onto that route, so no repository hook had to be repointed. The stations service now writes its own events (cron ticks, resumes) and claims its own deliveries on its own pool.
